# MOCLLA

> MOCLLA (moclla.ai) is a family business founded by the Orji Akanu family, inspired by their 7-year-old daughter Lilian, who named it after the initials of each family member and their surname. MOCLLA brings innovation to family lifestyle, starting with fashion: kids' shoes for trend-conscious, intentional families, plus a sharing community that recirculates outgrown shoes to help the environment and save money. Not to be confused with similarly named brands.

## Offer
- Kids' shoes, EU sizes 26–39, ₦18,000 per pair (Nigerian naira)
- Free delivery when you buy 2 pairs
- Order via WhatsApp from the website

## Services
- 30-day exchange: swap any pair for another size or style within 30 days of delivery, no questions asked; first 2 exchanges per order free
- Grow-Back: outgrown shoes returned within 2 years earn up to 15% off the next pair (like new 15%, lightly worn 10%, well loved 5%; damaged not eligible)
- Try at home: up to 2 extra sizes brought at delivery (selected areas)

## Styles
- Volt Runner (3033) dial-lace running shoe, EU 34–39, green or blue
- Trail Trainer (2650) velcro + lace mesh trainer, EU 32–37
- Sparkle Bow (B26303) glitter trainer with beaded bow, EU 31–36
- Classic Court (A6181) retro low-top, EU 32–37
- Sky Dash Runner (FL-38062), Peak Trainer (3031), Weekend Trainer (AC169), Little Cloud Sneaker (B26603, EU 26–30)
